author: paulvasi8
body:
I'm not sure this is the right section to post this so i'm sorry if it isn't
On July 14th, 2015 I was banned on the server for alleged hacking without any proof that I was. Indeed, I was not hacking. I then decided to give up on the server as I thought there was no point playing any longer. However, recently I have remembered this server and how much I enjoyed spending my time on it,  so I am now requesting to be unbanned as I believe I was unfairly banned and I want to play on this server again.

replies.author: Javipepe
replies.body:
Hello Paul,

Due to the fact that you have waited a considerable amount of time to be unbanned and you haven't ban evading ever since, I've decided to appeal your punishment and unban you. Please read the rules again just in case so you never break a rule. Welcome back!

Regards,
Javi
